inputs.original_text: It's troubling how quickly these stories get spun to attack modern institutions and blame everything on the supposed loss of personal responsibility. The new details tying South African actress Terry Pheto to alleged financial misconduct involving R20.56 million from the National Lotteries Commission, as laid out in the SIU probe during the briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, actually reveal the deeper failures of systems shaped by historical inequality. Public resources meant to support vulnerable communities end up caught in these patterns when institutions aren't properly reformed to root out discrimination and protect the marginalized, and we need stronger structural changes focused on labor rights and equity rather than outdated narratives that ignore the root causes.
